en.description:
WatchABC turns your Apple Watch into a fun, interactive learning tool for kids. Swipe through colorful flashcards, tap to hear words spoken aloud, and test knowledge with emoji-powered quizzes - all from the wrist.

CARD SETS (11 total)
- ABC - Capital letters
- abc - Small letters
- AEIOU - Capital vowels
- aeiou - Small vowels
- 123 - Numbers 0-9
- Days - Days of the week
- Months - Months of the year
- Animals - A-Z animals with matching emoji
- Cars - A-Z car brands
- Colors - 10 colors with gradient backgrounds
- Shapes - 10 shapes with SF Symbols

INTERACTIVE FLASHCARDS
Swipe down to go forward, swipe up to go back. Cards follow your finger with natural physics and a cascading stack effect - so it actually feels like flipping through real flashcards.

QUIZ MODE
See an emoji clue and pick the right answer from 3 large, easy-to-tap buttons. Progress dots track your score in real time with red and green feedback. Finish all 10 questions to see your final score.

TAP TO SPEAK
Tap any card to hear it pronounced clearly. Choose between a Male or Female voice, or turn voice off entirely in Settings.

HAPTIC FEEDBACK
Feel every swipe and quiz result on your wrist. Haptics can be turned on or off in Settings.

SETTINGS
Customize your experience with voice on/off, voice type (Male/Female), and haptic feedback toggle. Settings are saved across app launches.

ACCESSIBILITY
Full VoiceOver support with descriptive labels on every element.

WATCH-ONLY
No iPhone required. WatchABC runs independently on your Apple Watch.
en.releaseNotes:
WatchABC 2.0 is here - completely reimagined with a new look, new features, and a much more fun experience for kids!

INTERACTIVE CARD STACK
Cards now follow your finger as you swipe. Swipe down for the next card, swipe up to go back. A cascading stack of 4 cards with smooth color transitions makes it feel like real flashcards.

QUIZ MODE
Tap Quiz on any card set. An emoji clue appears - pick the right answer from 3 big colorful buttons. Red and green dots track your progress, and a score screen celebrates at the end.

NEW LOOK
Playful pastel bubbles on the main menu, bold rounded fonts, and a brand new app icon.

NEW CARD SETS
Colors (10 colors with gradient backgrounds) and Shapes (10 shapes with SF Symbols) - both with Quiz mode.

VOICE SETTINGS
Choose Male or Female voice, or turn voice off entirely. New haptic feedback toggle too - all in the Settings card at the bottom of the menu.

HAPTIC FEEDBACK
Feel every swipe, correct answer and wrong answer on your wrist.

All 11 card sets: ABC, abc, 123, Vowels, Days, Months, Animals, Cars, Colors and Shapes.
en.subtitle: Flashcards for kids
